name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You have done an exemplary job, adventurer. It is now time to send you on your last mission.

General Angerforge, the Dark Iron responsible for coordinating the attacks on the 109th division of the K.E.F. and the mass slaughter of our forces must be brought to justice.

This will undoubtedly be your most grueling mission, but should you succeed, you will be richly rewarded.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.
narrative.offerRewardText: Finally! The villain been brought to justice! You are a remarkable individual, adventurer. Wear this medallion as a symbol of your stalwart dedication to the Horde and the K.E.F.
narrative.requestItemsText: Has the Butcher of Blackrock been disposed of?
